def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # normalize species labels (strip spaces, fix typo) - not needed for island counts but harmless
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().replace({'Chinstarp': 'Chinstrap'})
    # drop exact duplicate rows (duplicate penguin measurements)
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # fix impossible measurements: negative flipper lengths, out-of-range body mass
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    counts = df.dropna(subset=['island']).groupby('island').size()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
